record.field: Employee portal accounting: prepare and post directly in configured journals. Resetting posted records requires an internal permission request. No internal accounting access is granted. Preparer membership takes precedence and requires review.
Restricted preparation: submit bills, entries and vouchers for independent approval. Applies to portal and internal staff; internal staff use native forms. Does not grant internal accounting access.

Approve restricted accounting submissions from portal and internal preparers. Internal approvers work in native forms. Self-approval is prohibited. CEO planning decisions retain the existing CEO role.
Read the accounting workspace within configured company and journal boundaries.

Customer invoice workspace in allowed company sales journals. May prepare and post invoices (Preparer membership still requires independent approval). Does not grant Sales quotation or native internal access.
